name: merge-cli
description: Predict the pathogenicity of human genetic variants with the MERGE ensemble.

interface.longDescription: Scores a human genetic variant with the MERGE ensemble, which combines 14 sequence and protein models over four variant classes (coding, splice, noncoding, non-SNV). Returns the probability together with the gene, the MANE Select transcript, the ClinVar record when one exists, and explicit caveats saying when the score should not be trusted. Requires merge-cli to be installed: pip install "merge-cli[mcp]".
defaultPrompt: Is this variant likely pathogenic or benign, and what does ClinVar say?
